The affected families gathered outside the Taipei City Government to hold a press conference and express their protest, waving signs and shouting in unison, "The builder has no fault". Trump was asked by the media at an event at the White House this afternoon, did he discuss the release of political prisoners such as Min Xin and Li Zhiying at the Chuan Xue meeting last week?
